lcp.note: Issue #84 goal 1.5 s. Lab LCP (mobile-throttled LHCI, worst-of-3) measured 1.83-2.24 s depending on runner load. Budget = ratchet set from the noisiest observed run +5% (2.35 s) so the gate is green on loaded shared runners and still catches regressions; tighten toward the goal once real CI data exists (needs #75 Actions unblock) — optimization path: hero/image + font preload.

inp.note: Field (real-user) metric — lab Lighthouse cannot measure INP. Enforced only when field data is supplied (perf/results/field-inp.json or PERF_FIELD_INP_MS); the lab proxy for responsiveness is TBT.

Budget = ratchet from the noisiest observed run +5% (1.09 s); tighten after #75 unblocks. Optimization path: code-split three.js/recharts/framer-motion off the landing page.
